evidence.detail: R40 GameObject (rs/l), GroundDecoration (rs/m), WallDecoration (rs/T) and WallObject (rs/U) all extend rs/Q directly, while GroundItemPile (rs/n) deliberately does not.
The three rs/Q integers are inherited as the common scene tag plus world-space X/Y coordinates. Scene construction writes the same tag/X/Y roles into each of the four subclasses.

Client scene lookup returns rs/Q and searches the SceneTile wall, wall-decoration, ground-decoration and GameObject slots by their inherited scene tag, proving rs/Q is the shared scene-object record rather than a renderable/model base.

proposals.note: SceneEntity is the conservative semantic recovery name for the shared scene-holder base record. It is distinct from Renderable and from the concrete GameObject type, and does not claim a verbatim original identifier.
